Mood: setting it up for the first time, out of the box. Flat-lay editorial photography. Photographic realism, no illustration, no text anywhere outside the screen.

shots.name: reel
shots.prompt:
A locked-off camera on an empty powered wheelchair standing in a wide, bright corridor. The camera does not move at all: no pan, no push in, no handheld drift. The wheelchair does not move or roll. Nobody enters the frame.

The only motion is ambient: daylight from the tall windows brightens very slightly and returns as a thin cloud passes, the shadows on the floor lengthening a fraction and coming back, and dust drifting slowly in the light.

The interface on the chair's small mounted screen stays completely still and unchanged throughout — no elements move, no text changes, nothing appears or disappears. Treat the screen as a fixed photograph.

The light returns exactly to where it began so the final frame matches the first frame and the clip loops seamlessly.

Style: still, institutional, patient. Photographic realism. No camera movement, no cuts, no transitions, no added graphics, no text overlays.
